name: Firearm
description: al Specialization " pfs="" > Firearm Source Guns & Gears pg. 152 The target must succeed at a Fortitude save against your class DC or be stunned 1.

name: Crossbow
description: al Specialization " pfs="" > Crossbow Source Player Core pg. 283 The target takes 1d8 persistent bleed damage. You gain an item bonus to this bleed damage equal to the weapon's item bonus to attack rolls.

name: Flail
description: tical Specialization " pfs="" > Flail Source Player Core pg. 283 The target is knocked prone unless they succeed at a Reflex save against your class DC.

name: Hammer
description: ical Specialization " pfs="" > Hammer Source Player Core pg. 283 The target is knocked prone unless they succeed at a Fortitude save against your class DC.

name: Axe
description: ritical Specialization " pfs="" > Axe Source Player Core pg. 283 Choose one creature adjacent to the initial target and within reach. If its AC is lower than your attack roll result for the critical hit, you deal damage to that creature equal to the result of the weapon damage die you rolled (including extra dice for its striking rune, if any). This amount isn't doubled, and no bonuses or other additional dice apply to this damage.

name: Bomb
description: itical Specialization " pfs="" > Bomb Source Player Core pg. 283 Increase the radius of the bomb's splash damage (if any) to 10 feet.

name: Bow
description: ritical Specialization " pfs="" > Bow Source Player Core pg. 283 If the target of the critical hit is adjacent to a surface, it gets stuck to that surface by the missile. The target is immobilized and must spend an Interact action to attempt a DC 10 Athletics check to pull the missile free; it can't move from its space until it succeeds. The creature doesn't become stuck if it is incorporeal, is liquid (like a water elemental or some oozes), or could otherwise escape without effort.

name: Brawling
description: al Specialization " pfs="" > Brawling Source Player Core pg. 283 The target must succeed at a Fortitude save against your class DC or be slowed 1 until the end of your next turn.

name: Club
description: itical Specialization " pfs="" > Club Source Player Core pg. 283 You knock the target away from you up to 10 feet (you choose the distance). This is forced movement.

name: Dart
description: itical Specialization " pfs="" > Dart Source Player Core pg. 283 The target takes 1d6 persistent bleed damage. You gain an item bonus to this bleed damage equal to the weapon's item bonus to attack rolls.

name: Knife
description: tical Specialization " pfs="" > Knife Source Player Core pg. 283 The target takes 1d6 persistent bleed damage. You gain an item bonus to this bleed damage equal to the weapon's item bonus to attack rolls.

name: Pick
description: itical Specialization " pfs="" > Pick Source Player Core pg. 283 The weapon viciously pierces the target, who takes 2 additional damage per weapon damage die.

name: Polearm
description: cal Specialization " pfs="" > Polearm Source Player Core pg. 283 The target is moved 5 feet in a direction of your choice. This is forced movement.

name: Shield
description: ical Specialization " pfs="" > Shield Source Player Core pg. 283 You knock the target back from you 5 feet. This is forced movement.

name: Sling
description: tical Specialization " pfs="" > Sling Source Player Core pg. 283 The target must succeed at a Fortitude save against your class DC or be stunned 1.

name: Spear
description: tical Specialization " pfs="" > Spear Source Player Core pg. 283 The weapon pierces the target, weakening its attacks. The target is clumsy 1 until the start of your next turn.

name: Sword
description: tical Specialization " pfs="" > Sword Source Player Core pg. 283 The target is made off-balance by your attack, becoming flat-footed until the start of your next turn.
